attributes.authority: the Roadwarden Statute — four articles; see the lore-event 'The Sealing of the Roadwarden Statute' for the text
attributes.blind_spot: it reads every threat to the Road as a threat to the people on it, and is sincere about this
attributes.founded: RR 1 (two centuries before the present, RR 203)
attributes.how_to_use_the_two_words: Iseul Fane says the Wardenry, always, as does anyone speaking inside the law. Ysoly, her hands, the depot at the Dry Ferry and the rim brokers say the Wardens, or the Roadwardens when they are being careful, or when they are naming the body to somebody who does not live under it. The Assembly writes the Wardenry and says the Wardens at table. The adjective survives in both registers because it is not the name: a Roadwarden post, a Roadwarden relay, a Roadwarden outrider, the Roadwarden Statute - nobody has ever said a Wardenry post. Singular for a person of any rank is a Warden. The drift is usable in prose: an officer who says the Wardens has stopped speaking as one of them, and a hand who says the Wardenry is quoting somebody.
attributes.internal_fracture: the surveyors' branch is certified by the College of Levels and sealed by it, so a Warden-surveyor answers to two bodies with one seal — which is how the water survey came to exist at all
attributes.leverage: no caravan crosses unlicensed, and no well within the bounds opens without a Warden to open it
attributes.names: Two names, one body, and no ambiguity about which is which. THE WARDENRY is the formal name and the statutory one: the document of RR 1 created the body in the act of describing it, and every article says the Wardenry - 'within the bounds the Wardenry answers for the crossings'. It is the word on a roll, a seal, a licence, a summons and an inquiry finding, and it is how the body refers to itself. THE ROADWARDENS is the common name, and it is really a plural of the officers rather than a name for the institution: what anyone on the plain actually meets is a woman on a horse with a stamp at her neck, so the body gets named after her. Hands shorten it again to the Wardens. Nobody is wrong, and nobody is talking about two different things.
attributes.ranks: First through Seventh. A Warden of the Third Rank or above may declare a hazard under the Fourth Article; below the Third, they may only inspect and report.
attributes.revenue: licence fees and well-tolls, assessed and paid in salt

name: The Roadwardens
summary: The licensing body for every crossing of the Meniscus, seated at Bell Harrow and chartered by the statute it wrote for itself in RR 1. It surveys the routes, fires the licence tiles, opens and closes the wells, and takes a cut of every load that moves between the rim-cities. Two centuries of doing this competently have left it unable to imagine a Meniscus that does not need crossing.
